field_descriptions.code: A medical code for the entity, taken from a controlled vocabulary or ontology such as ICD-9, DiseasesDB, MeSH, SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, etc.
field_descriptions.funding: A [[Grant]] that directly or indirectly provide funding or sponsorship for this item. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].
field_descriptions.guideline: A medical guideline related to this entity.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.legal_status: The drug or supplement's legal status, including any controlled substance schedules that apply.
field_descriptions.medicine_system: The system of medicine that includes this MedicalEntity, for example 'evidence-based', 'homeopathic', 'chiropractic', etc.
field_descriptions.recognizing_authority: If applicable, the organization that officially recognizes this entity as part of its endorsed system of medicine.
field_descriptions.relevant_specialty: If applicable, a medical specialty in which this entity is relevant.
field_descriptions.study: A medical study or trial related to this entity.
